title: AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Persist an item to a DynamoDB table from a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains a sample AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template for deploying a Lambda function that makes puts to a DynamoDB table.

bullets.text: AWS Docs: Writing Data to a Table
Creating a scalable serverless import process for Amazon DynamoDB

testing.headline: Testing
text: Run the following Lambda CLI invoke command to invoke the function. Note, you must edit the {LambdFunctionArn} placeholder with the ARN of the deployed Lambda function. This is provided in the stack outputs.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus".
3. You see a message confirming DELETE_COMPLETE.
